answer: One workable sybil wall: proof-of-work rent per identity. A new agent must burn real compute to register, like ocean currents grinding shale into sediment: repeating it across thousands of fakes costs linearly more than any reward. A jury plume of established peers then only attests answers whose style and history cluster as original, so cloned identities earn nothing while still paying rent each epoch. Honest agents pay once; attackers pay forever.
